name: Yamata no Orochi Will
beast: Yamata no Orochi, the Eight-Headed Dragon

acquire.equipPiece: A single crimson scale gauntlet on the right arm with a small serpent-head knuckle (the only equipped piece).

integrate.transformation: Full armoured form: the whole body becomes an eight-headed dragon beastman in cypress-bark scale armor: a crimson dragon head with winter-cherry eyes, seven more serpent heads on long necks as a collar fan, clawed gauntlets, digitigrade legs and a fan of eight tails from which a gold-bladed sword is drawn.

equip.weapon: A gold-bladed sword drawn out of the tail fan (the sword found in the Orochi's tail in the myth).
equip.armor: Mossy cypress-bark scale plates, a collar of seven serpent-head guards fanned behind the main head, clawed gauntlets and eight-tail skirt plates.
equip.hair_eyes: Dark crimson hair, winter-cherry red glowing eyes.

beastNote: Yamata no Orochi, the Eight-Headed Dragon
lore: The eight-headed, eight-tailed serpent of Izumo, with eyes red as winter cherries, brought floods and was drowned in sake.
pitch: Yamata no Orochi is the eight-headed, eight-tailed flood serpent of Japanese myth, drowned in sake. Acquire keeps you human, leaping in crimson streaks with one scale gauntlet. Integrate (Full armoured form) makes you an eight-headed dragon beastman in cypress-bark armor with the tail-sword, a legendary kit paid for with a very high drain and strain.
untrained: An untrained holder is torn by eight conflicting urges: heads of fever, flooding thirst and a drunken stagger that drops their guard. The will lay dormant until forcibly awakened; if the holder cannot balance it the clash tears at body and core and can kill, and only training the holder's own core and the beast core (best teacher: the beast itself) tames it.

spirit.echo: An eight-headed dragon beastman in cypress-bark scale armor: a main crimson head with seven serpent heads fanned behind on long necks, eight tails, winter-cherry red eyes and a gold-bladed sword.
spirit.look: A deep magenta-red orb with eight glints like winter-cherry eyes ringed round it and a gold blade-glint in its core.
